ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel surface with a high-intensity (white) to low-intensity ratio of approximately 1:9 across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and lower regions comprise a contiguous low-intensity dark mass. High-contrast white mottling and discrete circular focal spots are mapped to the distal tips and sporadically across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 40 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 4-15 pixels against the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep on the trailing margins tapering into acute, upward-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme outer margins and superior tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal light-gray linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark surface of the right mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting rosette scarring on the distal extremities of both fluke lobes.
